description: Derived from AGSC-05-21: two published items of one `type` where a `title` or an alias of one equals a `title` or an alias of the other, after NFC and case folding, are the warning AGSC-E416, carried by the later item in path order and naming the earlier. `the-coordinator` and `the-dispatcher` share the alias Router (case differs): the finding is on `the-dispatcher`. The title of `planner`, Dispatch plan, equals the alias of `scheduler`: the finding is on `scheduler`. Raising nothing: a draft concept with the same alias (not published, AGSC-06-30), a cluster with the same alias (not the concept type), and `echo`, whose own alias equals its own title (one item is not a pair). The whole list is two warnings and lint exits 0. The released case `lint-0041` states the title half and stays valid.
